audi.name: Audi R8 V10 Performance
audi.description: The Audi R8 delivers supercar performance with everyday usability. It features a naturally aspirated 5.2L V10 engine. The interior is wrapped in fine leather and carbon trim. Quattro all-wheel drive offers maximum traction. Ideal for those who crave both speed and style.

audi.name: Audi RS7 Sportback
audi.description: Aggressive design meets luxurious comfort. Twin-turbocharged V8 for thrilling acceleration. Spacious interior with advanced tech. Adaptive air suspension for smooth rides. A bold statement on every road.

audi.name: Audi Q8 e-tron
audi.description: Fully electric SUV with bold Audi design. Smooth acceleration and long-range capability. Quiet cabin with premium features. Digital cockpit with intuitive controls. Perfect for eco-conscious drivers.

audi.name: Audi A6 Allroad
audi.description: Blends wagon comfort with SUV strength. Rugged looks with chrome accents. Air suspension adapts to any terrain. Interior built for luxury and utility. A reliable partner for adventures.

audi.name: Audi TT RS
audi.description: Compact coupe with sharp styling. Turbocharged five-cylinder engine roars. Quattro system delivers superior grip. Sport seats and virtual cockpit inside. A thrilling ride in every curve.

audi.name: Audi Q5
audi.description: Compact luxury SUV with tech-loaded cabin. Smooth ride with excellent handling. Efficient turbocharged engine. Virtual cockpit and wireless connectivity. Stylish and practical for families.

bmw.name: BMW M4 Competition
bmw.description: High-performance sports coupe with bold grille. Twin-turbo inline-6 engine for serious power. Sport-tuned chassis for responsive handling. M-specific interior details. Designed for track and road alike.

bmw.name: BMW iX
bmw.description: BMW’s futuristic electric SUV. Minimalist interior with curved screen display. Powerful dual-motor all-wheel drive. Luxurious, silent, and zero-emissions. A new era of sustainable driving.

bmw.name: BMW X5
bmw.description: Spacious midsize SUV with luxury features. Turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. Comfortable and composed ride quality. Large cargo space and towing capacity. Ideal for daily use or long trips.

bmw.name: BMW 330i
bmw.description: Classic BMW driving dynamics in a compact sedan. Efficient and quick turbo-four engine. Refined cabin with digital tech. Smooth ride and agile cornering. A well-rounded entry-level luxury car.

bmw.name: BMW Z4 Roadster
bmw.description: Sporty convertible with aggressive lines. Turbocharged inline-6 delivers a thrilling drive. Open-top fun with premium comfort. Driver-focused cockpit layout. Perfect for weekend cruising.

chevrolet.name: Chevrolet Corvette Stingray
chevrolet.description: Mid-engine sports car with iconic styling. V8 engine for powerful launches. Driver-centric cockpit with digital displays. Balanced handling and strong grip. American muscle redefined.

chevrolet.name: Chevrolet Tahoe
chevrolet.description: Large SUV built for family and adventure. Spacious three-row seating and cargo. V8 engine with towing strength. Tech-forward cabin with large screens. Dominates city or off-road.

chevrolet.name: Chevrolet Silverado
chevrolet.description: Durable full-size pickup truck. Off-road suspension and lifted stance. Crew cab with modern tech. Ready for heavy-duty tasks and trails. A workhorse with style.

chevrolet.name: Chevrolet Bolt EV
chevrolet.description: Affordable electric hatchback. Smooth, quiet, and efficient drive. Spacious for its size. Loaded with safety and tech features. Great for urban commuting.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Elantra N
hyundai.description: Sporty compact sedan with turbo power. Bold styling and aggressive accents. Engaging drive with manual gearbox. N-mode delivers sharper handling. Affordable and fun to drive.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Ioniq 6
hyundai.description: Streamlined EV with futuristic looks. Dual motors and long driving range. Minimal interior with big screens. Fast charging and efficient design. Next-gen mobility in style.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Tucson
hyundai.description: Compact SUV with cutting-edge design. Spacious interior with digital cluster. Smooth ride and smart safety tech. Available hybrid and AWD versions. Practical and efficient daily driver.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Palisade
hyundai.description: Flagship 3-row SUV with upscale finish. Roomy cabin and plush seating. Tech-rich infotainment system. Smooth power delivery and ride comfort. Ideal for large families.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Kona N
hyundai.description: High-performance small SUV. Turbocharged engine with sport exhaust. Unique N styling inside and out. Compact size, big personality. Great for spirited urban drives.

hyundai.name: Hyundai Santa Fe Hybrid
hyundai.description: Hybrid midsize SUV with all-wheel drive. Comfortable and family-friendly interior. Strong safety scores and tech. Great fuel economy for its size. Balanced blend of power and efficiency.

mercedes.name: Mercedes-AMG C63 S
mercedes.description: Track-bred sedan with premium luxury. Hand-built V8 engine roars. AMG ride control and dynamic handling. Sporty interior with high-end materials. Unmatched performance in its class.

mercedes.name: Mercedes EQS
mercedes.description: Flagship EV with futuristic luxury. Hyperscreen spans entire dashboard. Ultra-quiet ride and long range. Spacious cabin with ambient lighting. Sustainable, yet sophisticated.

mercedes.name: Mercedes GLC 300
mercedes.description: Compact luxury SUV with refined drive. MBUX infotainment with voice command. Premium materials and stylish finish. Smooth ride with agile handling. Everyday luxury with Mercedes elegance.
